name: certimate
description: An open-source and free self-hosted SSL certificates ACME tool, automates the full-cycle of issuance, deployment, renewal, and monitoring visually. 完全开源免费的自托管 SSL 证书 ACME 工具，申请、部署、续期、监控全流程自动化可视化，支持各大主流云厂商。

issues.title: [Bug] 工作流申请证书成功后，后续操作失败重试会重复申请证书
[Feature] 期望增加 metric 可以对接 promtheus
[Feature] 支持在新证书部署成功后，对旧证书进行处理
[Feature] 不以服务启动，通过命令行运行工作流
[Feature] Suggestions for optimization of some functions / 部分功能优化建议
[Feature]  导入 / 导出 / 轮转 ACME 账户凭据
[Feature] Deploy: Use certificate or workflow name as filename

latest_release.name: v0.4.37
latest_release.body:
# Changelog

## ✨ 新增功能
- Webhook 预设回调模板新增 Boop 选项

## 🐛 修复 Bug
- 修复 #1497：SSH 预设脚本中部署证书到群晖 DSM 时会破坏套件证书文件属组
- 修复 #1500：部署证书到 BytePlus 证书中心报错 "byteplusutil: service endpoint info missing: service 'certificate_service' not registered"
- 修复 #1506：部署证书到移动云 VLB 弹性负载均衡报错 "500 - REGION_ID_ERROR"

## 🛠 优化 & 其他改动
- 为 SSH 预设脚本加入 `set -u` 指令
- 优化部分文案

---

Comparing changes: https://github.com/certimate-go/certimate/compare/v0.4.36...v0.4.37, by @fudiwei, @nxcjs, @orshih6, @usual2970
